text:
Alyssa (CS): Quick flag - Tranquil Health renewal window. They want to move from 12mo to 9mo, add +15 seats, and pay via PO (net30) with a vendor code. They also want to send DocuSign from their own admin. Need: pricing confirmation, amendment doc, PO routing, and signer alignment.

Ravi (AE): Heard. Customer asks for a 12% concession on the prorated term (cites mid-year budget). I recommended 10% but they pushed. Can we do 12% as one-off?

Priya (Legal): 12% concession is OK from CS side but legal needs to check amendment language for the DPA exception they requested. Also need to ensure PO signer matches DocuSign signee or we get an executive attestation.

Marta (Ops): Billing checklist: vendor code, exact billing/legal entity name on PO, PO PDF uploaded to portal, billing contact email, and whether they need invoice via their procurement portal. If they're using their DocuSign, we need the envelope to be shared or CC ops@redwood.com.

Sam (Finance): On payment terms: net30 OK. If vendor code isn't provided in time, we need to know if we should provision on card and then replace invoice with PO reversal. Ops to confirm.

Alyssa (CS): I asked customer for vendor code + PO. They replied with vendor name but no code yet; they said CFO (name: L. Park) will sign. They also asked if we can consolidate billing for the 9mo term in one invoice.

Ravi (AE): CFO confirmed they'll upload PO today. I asked them to include "Tranquility Health Inc." exactly as legal name and billing@tranquil-health.org as billing email.

Alyssa (CS): Pricing snapshot (rounded):
```
List annual: $115,000
Prorate 9/12 -> 115000 * 9/12 = 86,250
Apply 12% concession -> 86250 * 0.88 = 75,900
Seats add: 15 * $48/mo * 9 = 6,480
Total due (9mo) = 75,900 + 6,480 = 82,380
Invoice: single net30 for $82,380
```

Marta (Ops): Got it. Ops will prepare an amendment SOW and draft invoice template. We cannot issue a PO-specific invoice until vendor code present in our system. If PO arrives within 48 hours, ops will backdate invoice to PO date. If not, we'll provision and issue invoice; finance will reconcile once PO arrives.

Priya (Legal): Regarding the DPA exception: customer provided suggested wording in their email. We can accept the exception if they sign with CFO and include a clause limiting applicability to this amendment only. Please attach their suggested text for legal review.

DocuSign Bot: Envelope created by Alyssa: https://docusign.example.com/envelope/TH-2026-09 - awaiting Tranquility signer (CFO L. Park). Envelope CC: legal@redwood.com, ops@redwood.com.

Alyssa (CS): Uploaded customer's suggested DPA clause to the DocuSign envelope. Asked CFO to confirm signer and to upload PO to portal.

Ravi (AE): Customer replied: PO will be uploaded within business day and signer will be CFO (matches envelope). They requested invoice to be sent to procurement@tranquil-health.org and billing@tranquil-health.org (both).

Sam (Finance): Please confirm billing emails in the PO match the portal upload. Once PO is in and vendor code created we can mark invoice ready. Finance needs vendor code to hit the correct accounts receivable bucket.

Marta (Ops): Action items: 1) Wait for PO upload + vendor code, 2) Ops to generate amendment & invoice draft, 3) Legal to sign off DPA clause upon matching signer, 4) Finance to prepare AR mapping. If PO delayed >72 hrs, ops to confirm provisioning on trial SOW to avoid downtime.

Priya (Legal): Once CFO signs DocuSign and PO, legal will sign the amendment. No other blockers expected.

Alyssa (CS): Checklist update: vendor code - pending, PO upload - pending, DocuSign envelope - created & CC'd, DPA clause - uploaded for legal review, invoice recipients confirmed. I'll follow up with CFO in 2 hours.

Ravi (AE): I'll chase CFO and post when PO is uploaded. Thanks all. :mega:
